SECOND SCHEDULE: (1) A  person  who  incurs  expenses  in  respect  of  depreciable

column1: assets  other  than  intangible  assets  during  a  year  of  assessment  shall  be
granted  enhanced  depreciation  allowances  computed  in  accordance
with  this  paragraph,  and  not,  depreciation  allowances  computed  under
the  Fourth  Schedule.

SECOND SCHEDULE: (2) A  depreciation  allowance  of  100%  of  the  expenses  incurred

column1: by  a  person  on  depreciable  assets,  other  than  intangible  assets  during
a  year  of  assessment  shall  be  granted  to  that  person  for  that  year
where  the  total  expenses  incurred  by  that  person  during  that  year  on
depreciable  assets  (other  than  intangible  assets)  that  are  used  in  a  part
of  Sri  Lanka  other  than  the  Northern  Province  exceeds  USD  3  million
but does not exceed USD 5 million, and where the person has employed
at  least  250  new  employees  during  the  year  of  assessment  with  those
new  employees  being  reported  in  the  statement  that  the  person,  as  a
withholding  agent,  is  required  to  file  under  section  79.
